note: OBTRAN 001's narration, rendered by tools/render-voices.mjs --comic obtran001 (the Render voices workflow runs it when this file changes on main). Narrator only: Myrddin (Paul, 25 October: fCxG8OHm4STbIsWe4aT9), Eleven v4, calm and measured as OBTRAN 003's narrator. The cards always show the lettering; the spoken text is spelt for saying: 3089 AD as "thirty eighty-nine AD", QNTM CNTRL and QNTM CTRL as "Quantum Control", 15 million zetabytes in words, OBTRAN as "Ob-tran". Raise a line's take for a fresh render of the same words.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [calm, measured] Epsilon Cygni, thirty eighty-nine AD. All life on the exoplanet Lyra has been obliterated...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [calm, measured] ...apart from the holosonic vessel, Quantum Control. It escapes the poisonous atmosphere, the legacy of an entire civilisation stowed on board...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [calm, measured] ...a DNA-encrypted lifeform! The final gift from the dying elders: fifteen million zettabytes of Lyra's sacred ethnology, imprinted into its cells. The sacred encryption known as the Oblivious Transfer!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [calm, measured] Four-dimensional manifold enabled, Quantum Control traverses the expanse of Cygnus A, into a slingshot that propels it into the orbit of an unknown planet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [calm, measured] Our fallen ship is intercepted by a scout patrol from an ancient tribe.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [calm, measured] Their plunder of Quantum Control's hold retrieves uranium, and the invaluable cryptid, still deep in hypersleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [calm, measured] In metabolic stasis, the psychedelic vibrations of their bonfire ritual...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [calm, measured] ...would soon trigger Ob-tran to begin its decode protocol.
